local_patches: numpy 2 fixes: int(np.max(...)) in scalesim/memory/read_buffer.py and double_buffered_scratchpad_mem.py

graph_provenance.notes: Encoder: onnx_graph_walk of WhisperEncoder built from the real config with random init (226 nodes -> 111 ops, 18.47 GMAC for the 30 s window). Mel front end and 12-token greedy decoder: config_derived. int8 weights are a deployment assumption. Period/deadline are reasonable defaults, not measured.

setup.bandwidth_mode: CALC (SCALE-Sim stall-free; stall_cycles_scalesim is 0 by construction)
setup.stall_model: stall_cycles_bw_model = max(0, dram_bytes / per_tile_bw - vx1_cycles), per_tile_bw = 28.44 B/cycle (DRAM peak / NPU clock / tiles)
setup.counts: SRAM reads/writes in words; DRAM in bytes (int8 1 B, bf16/fp32 2 B words)
setup.not_covered: elementwise, norm, softmax, pool, resize, memcopy, cpu/dsp kernels are not systolic GEMMs and stay on the L0/L1 NPU model
